before: A suggested link's edges carried the insertion around it, so another person's words typed before the link joined the insertion's card live and had a card of their own after a checkpoint. A suggestion inside a text box whose object no longer showed kept a card, though the saved file has no such text box. After a checkpoint, a move that another suggestion's words split into two ranges kept two ranges once those words were rejected. A prompt's units that content filled read as shown in isOrderedItemHidden, so a host counted a suggestion on them before a checkpoint and not after. A suggested paragraph property the paragraph already had made a suggestion and a card, which no Word file holds. A new column's cells or a new table inside another person's pending new row did not carry that row's insertion. A file move range whose words a direct deletion took out stayed after a decision on the move once folded, and a takeover inside a text box was lost at the second checkpoint.
after: Card reads pass over a link's edges, as Word and the editor mark only a link's words, and leave out a text box whose object went, as they leave out a note whose references show nowhere. Compose draws two ranges of one file move that nothing drawn separates as one range. Cards and exported files are the same live and after a checkpoint. isOrderedItemHidden also hides a prompt's units while content fills the control, as the cards do. A paragraph press the engine's op leaves as it shows makes no record. New cells and tables take the labels of the row or paragraph they go into, as a paste does. Compose passes over a file move range with nothing drawn inside, and draws a text box whose story holds a takeover from its story.
reason: The Yjs document format, the ordered protocol and the checkpoint manifest do not change. Cards are read from the room's state with the same code on every copy, and every copy of a room runs the same code version. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet.
